text_block_list.text:
I brought Rulership to an amusement park 
so she could have some fun, but—

text_block_list.name: Amusement Park Staff A
text_block_list.text:
The street is currently crowded! Please 
proceed slowly~!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
At this rate, having fun is out of the 
question. Knowing when to give up is 
important too, you know?

This level of crowding was expected. It's 
time to put into action the tactics I 
devised for today.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
It's deserted over here... Or rather, 
there's not a soul walking around.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"Under Renovation: Authorized Personnel 
Only"— It avoids the crowd, but isn't that 
cutting corners?

text_block_list.name: Amusement Park Staff B
text_block_list.text: Ah, hey! You two over there!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: See?! The judge spotted us!

text_block_list.name: Amusement Park Staff B
text_block_list.text:
You're the test player for our new 
attraction, right? This way, please!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Zombie
text_block_list.text: OAAAAAAAHHH!!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Haha, great reaction. Sounded just like a 
game over death rattle.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Still, to think you applied in advance for 
the haunted house test run.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, thanks to that, it was quite an 
interesting experience. Hehehe, I can look 
forward to what comes next, right?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it's getting quite lively around here. 
...Ah, the parade is about to start.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"Still, at this rate, we'll be trapped in 
the crowd and won't be able to see a 
thing. Well now... what's your move, 
Trainer?"

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Why are you dressed like this—

text_block_list.name: Amusement Park Staff B
text_block_list.text:
Ah, you're one of the parade participants 
who won the lottery. Congratulations! 
Please, have a wonderful time!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Incredible, you prepared for this too?! If 
you're part of the parade itself, then the 
crowd congestion doesn't matter at all.
(*tatta-ra-tan-tan, ta-ra-ra-ra-tan♪*)

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, such sharp dancing. From this 
distance, I can even see their facial 
expressions clearly.
(BAAAANG!!)

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha, this blizzard of blossoms is quite 
striking. Something like this isn't so bad 
once in a while.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
I never imagined a day would come where 
I'd enjoy an amusement park this way. It's 
far better than just playing around 
normally.

"Though it was an irregular approach, it 
seems they enjoyed it. Now, as for the 
rest—"
choice_data_list:
Let's finish by taking in the night view 
from the Ferris wheel!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
—Hm? The Ferris wheel is closed for the 
day. Look, on that signboard over there.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
That look on your face... Don't tell me 
you hadn't noticed?
choice_data_list:
I spent too much time on other things... 
Sorry.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"...It's too early to apologize. 
Naturally, it's too early to surrender, 
too."

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Devise tactics and unexpected ploys. There 
is always a way to break through.
choice_data_list:
Still, once time's up, there's nothing we 
can—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
—Today, you made the impossible possible. 
You can do it. I know you can.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Surprise me once more, Trainer.

I want Rulership to enjoy herself. I'll 
stay true to that feeling until the very 
end...!

text_block_list.name: Staff
text_block_list.text:
Last call for the Night Ferris Wheel! 
Anyone wishing to ride, please come this 
way~!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh, so you saw a way forward not 
inside the amusement park, but from the 
Ferris wheel outside.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Impressive that you found it in the 
eleventh hour. For something slapped 
together, it's a solid plan.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to that, I can enjoy myself all the 
way to the end. Nice play, Trainer.
choice_data_list: I'm so glad I didn't give up...
It's all thanks to your encouragement.
It's all thanks to your encouragement!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to that, I can enjoy myself all the 
way to the end. Nice play, Trainer.
choice_data_list: I'm so glad I didn't give up...
It's all thanks to your encouragement.
It's all thanks to your encouragement!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
It was that tenacity that brought this 
Ferris wheel within our grasp.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
If not just their gameplay, but their 
mental strength has grown too, then—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe, I'm looking forward to our next 
online match.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
You are a worthy rival, and a wonderful 
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Not only that, seeing all of today's 
tactics really thrilled me.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Congratulations. You've earned my words.
